intervention_label: Dual-biomarker workup: DLL3 IHC (SP347) + PRAME IHC + HLA-A*02:01 typing
expected_benefit: Resolves which of the two targetable-feature pathways is reachable. DLL3 IHC SP347 ≥1% (preferably ≥25%) gates DLL3-directed options (ranks 2-3). PRAME IHC + HLA-A*02:01 typing together gate PRAME-directed options (ranks 4-5) — both are required because every PRAME-targeting drug in clinical development is HLA-A*02:01-restricted.
key_risks: 1-3 week turnaround for IHC; HLA typing same-day to one week
if BOTH workups negative, both targetable-feature pathways are foreclosed and the case has no within-scope recommendations
preference_alignment: Aligns with all stated preferences — non-toxic, runs on archival tissue + a blood draw for HLA typing.
guideline_status: Implicit in every targeted-therapy guideline; specifically required by NCT06788938 (DLL3) and the IMA203 / brenetafusp / IMC-P115C eligibility criteria (PRAME + HLA).
rationale_summary: All five personas converged on the dual workup as the precondition. RNA expression alone does not establish either DLL3 protein-level membrane density (required for ImmTAC-class DLL3 drugs) or PRAME peptide presentation on HLA-A*02:01 (required for every PRAME ImmTAC and TCR-T). The two workups are independent and can run in parallel.
open_questions: SP347 DLL3 IHC assay availability at the treating institution
PRAME IHC clone availability and threshold (≥1% vs ≥10% varies by program)
HLA-A*02:01 typing turnaround and lab availability
likelihood_of_effect: Diagnostic certainty — resolves which of two targetable-feature pathways is open. Both are independent; either or both may confirm.
toxicity_burden: Low (none — diagnostic IHC on archival tissue + a single blood draw for HLA typing)
overall: Non-toxic dual workup that gates ranks 2-5; run all three tests in parallel regardless of which therapy is ultimately chosen.

expected_benefit: If mechanism translates from SCLC: median OS 13.6 vs 8.3 mo (HR 0.60) in DeLLphi-304 SCLC; ORR ~40% in DeLLphi-301. Cross-tumor extrapolation to osteosarcoma is unproven — the trial design exists precisely to test this.
key_risks: no prior osteosarcoma data — cross-tumor translation is the open question
preference_alignment: Strong match: high-risk-high-reward + prefers_trials. Conditional on positive DLL3 IHC.
guideline_status: Off-guideline for osteosarcoma; trial enrollment is NCCN cat-1 for relapsed disease.
rationale_summary: Conditional on positive DLL3 IHC. Conservative's earlier toxicity veto was contingent on biomarker confirmation and lifts here. Concensusite endorses on guideline-aligned trial-enrollment principle. The critic's evidence-quality dissent persists (no published osteosarcoma data with tarlatamab; cross-tumor translation unproven). Two endorsements from round 1 (risktaker, advocate) plus the post-IHC veto-lift from conservative and qualified-now-endorse from concensusite yield a positive agreement score. Foreclosed if IHC negative.
open_questions: Slot availability at NCT06788938 enrolling sites
Cross-tumor translatability of DLL3 BiTE mechanism — first osteosarcoma cohort
likelihood_of_effect: Cross-tumor extrapolation: SCLC OS HR 0.60 (DeLLphi-304); ORR ~40% (DeLLphi-301). Osteosarcoma efficacy is the open question NCT06788938 will answer.
toxicity_burden: Moderate (CRS ~50% mostly G1-2; CRS G≥3 ~1%; ICANS-like ~10%; inpatient cycle-1 step-up dosing required)

counter_productive_moa.description: On-mechanism CNS bystander T-cell activation drives ICANS; possible DLL3 antigen-loss escape on repeated dosing

overall: The only DLL3-directed option when IHC is positive — preference-aligned but cross-tumor translation untested; foreclosed if IHC negative.

intervention_label: SHR-4849 / IDE849 via NCT07174583 (IDEAYA pan-tumor DLL3 basket)
expected_benefit: Mechanism-distinct alternative to tarlatamab — DLL3-targeting ADC with TOP1-inhibitor payload. No published clinical data yet (phase 1/2 ongoing). Pan-tumor 'DLL3-expressing tumors' basket eligibility in principle accepts non-SCLC, but osteosarcoma fit on the eligibility list requires direct sponsor confirmation.
key_risks: Osteosarcoma eligibility on the basket is UNCONFIRMED — needs sponsor outreach
no published clinical data for SHR-4849 yet (first-in-class signal pending)
ADC class toxicities expected: cytopenias, GI, possible ILD
TAHOE-era PBD-warhead failure (Rova-T) is a class shadow, but SHR-4849 uses a different (TOP1-inhibitor) payload
preference_alignment: Aligns with prefers_trials + high-risk-high-reward. Conditional on positive DLL3 IHC AND IDEAYA confirming osteosarcoma is in scope.
guideline_status: Off-guideline; investigational. Not yet on any NCCN / ESMO recommendation.
rationale_summary: Pan-tumor DLL3-expressing-tumors basket from IDEAYA. Mechanism plausibly applies to DLL3+ osteosarcoma the same way tarlatamab does, with the second-mechanism-class advantage that if the BiTE path fails or is foreclosed (cycle-1 CRS intolerance, antigen-loss escape), an ADC pathway remains. The critic dissents on evidence base (no published clinical data for SHR-4849); the conservative dissents on osteosarcoma eligibility uncertainty. Risktaker and advocate endorse on the basket-trial principle. Status considered_with_caveats because |dissent|=2 — the user (or treating team) should reach IDEAYA directly before pursuing.
open_questions: Does IDEAYA's basket explicitly include osteosarcoma in scope, or is it SCLC/NEC-weighted in practice?
Trial slot availability and timeline if osteosarcoma is accepted
Is concurrent enrollment with NCT06788938 permitted, or is one foreclosed by participation in the other?
scenario_label: If DLL3 IHC ≥1% AND sponsor confirms osteosarcoma eligibility
likelihood_of_effect: Speculative. No published clinical data for SHR-4849. TOP1-inhibitor-payload ADC precedent (T-DXd, sacituzumab govitecan) suggests the payload class can produce response signals, but DLL3-specific efficacy is the open question.
toxicity_burden: Unknown — no published clinical data. TOP1-inhibitor ADC class effects expected: cytopenias, GI toxicity, possible ILD/pneumonitis (DXd-class ADCs carry an ILD signal worth monitoring).

counter_productive_moa.description: ADC bystander toxicity to DLL3-low normal tissue; antigen-loss escape on repeated dosing; PBD-payload class shadow (Rova-T TAHOE) does not directly apply but informs the toxicity-budget framing.

overall: Mechanism-distinct second DLL3 pathway pending sponsor confirmation of osteosarcoma eligibility — relevant if the tarlatamab path is foreclosed or fails.

intervention_label: IMA203 (PRAME-TCR-T) via NCT03686124 (Immatics ACTengine pan-solid basket)
expected_benefit: ORR 54% in the cross-tumor PRAME+ HLA-A*02:01+ cohort (n=28, Wermke 2024); responses durable at 9-mo follow-up. Pan-solid basket explicitly includes sarcoma cohorts. Mechanism-distinct from DLL3 BiTEs — the PRAME pathway opens whether or not DLL3 IHC confirms.
key_risks: 1 treatment-related death in published cohort (septic shock post-Cy/Flu)
manufacturing turnaround for autologous TCR-T (typically 4-6 weeks)
preference_alignment: Aligns with prefers_trials + high-risk-high-reward. Conditional on positive PRAME IHC AND HLA-A*02:01-positive typing.
guideline_status: Off-guideline; investigational. Pan-solid basket eligibility is published and protocolized.
rationale_summary: Pan-solid PRAME+ HLA-A*02:01+ TCR-T basket from Immatics. Mechanism-class diversification from DLL3 (immunology-driven targeted antigen recognition rather than antibody-Fab). Best clinical-efficacy signal in the PRAME class to date (54% ORR in Wermke 2024 across heavily pretreated solid tumors). The conservative dissents on autologous-cell-therapy logistics and CRS infrastructure; risktaker, advocate, concensusite endorse on the basket-trial principle and the published efficacy. Critic abstains (no objection but no strong endorsement either).
open_questions: Sarcoma-cohort slot availability at NCT03686124 enrolling sites
Treating institution's CAR-T / TCR-T infrastructure (Cy/Flu lymphodepletion, CRS monitoring)
Sequencing relative to a DLL3-directed pathway if both biomarkers confirm
scenario_label: If PRAME IHC positive AND HLA-A*02:01 typing positive
likelihood_of_effect: Strong. ORR 54% (95% CI 34-73) in pan-solid PRAME+ HLA-A*02:01+ cohort (Wermke 2024 Lancet Oncol, n=28). Sarcoma cohorts on protocol; osteosarcoma fit unconfirmed but eligibility is mechanism-driven, not tumor-restricted.
toxicity_burden: High (CRS ~100% — G3-4 ~10%; ICANS-like ~25%; uniform post-Cy/Flu cytopenias; one treatment-related death in published cohort; CAR-T-style infusion infrastructure required)

counter_productive_moa.description: On-target / off-tumor toxicity to PRAME-expressing normal testis is class-managed (testis is immune-privileged); CRS / neurotoxicity from T-cell activation is the main mechanism-level risk

overall: Best-evidenced PRAME pathway with pan-solid sarcoma-inclusive basket; conditional on PRAME IHC + HLA-A*02:01 typing both confirming.

intervention_label: IMC-P115C via NCT07156136 (Immunocore next-gen PRAME ImmTAC pan-tumor)
expected_benefit: Pan-tumor PRAME+ HLA-A*02:01+ ImmTAC bispecific. Mechanism class-validated via brenetafusp (NCT04262466 / Hamid 2024 Cancer Discov) — same ImmTAC platform used for tebentafusp (approved in uveal melanoma). No published clinical data for IMC-P115C yet (first-in-human ongoing).
key_risks: No published clinical data for IMC-P115C (relies on brenetafusp class precedent)
ImmTAC class CRS ~85% (mostly G1-2 in brenetafusp); rash; transient hypotension
weekly IV infusion with pre-medication for CRS mitigation
osteosarcoma fit on the basket eligibility list is plausible but unconfirmed
preference_alignment: Aligns with prefers_trials. Conditional on positive PRAME IHC AND HLA-A*02:01 + sponsor confirmation osteosarcoma is in scope.
rationale_summary: Mechanism-class alternative to IMA203 in the PRAME space. ImmTAC platform is class-validated (tebentafusp approved; brenetafusp in pivotal phase 3). The critic dissents on no-published-clinical-data for IMC-P115C; the conservative dissents on osteosarcoma eligibility uncertainty. Risktaker and advocate endorse on the basket-trial principle plus the second-mechanism-class hedge (ImmTAC if TCR-T fails or is foreclosed). Status considered_with_caveats because |dissent|=2.
open_questions: Does the IMC-P115C basket explicitly include sarcoma in scope, or is it melanoma-weighted?
Sequencing if both IMA203 (rank 4) and IMC-P115C are reachable
ImmTAC weekly-infusion logistics versus one-shot TCR-T infusion
scenario_label: If PRAME IHC positive AND HLA-A*02:01 typing positive AND sponsor confirms osteosarcoma
likelihood_of_effect: Speculative. No published clinical data for IMC-P115C; relies on brenetafusp class precedent (ORR ~9% in heavily pretreated melanoma; durable in subset).
toxicity_burden: Moderate (ImmTAC class: CRS ~85% mostly G1-2; rash ~70%; transient hypotension; pre-medication-managed)

counter_productive_moa.description: ImmTAC on-target / off-tumor signal in PRAME-expressing normal tissue (low; testis-restricted); CRS from T-cell activation

overall: Mechanism-class alternative to IMA203 in the PRAME space, contingent on PRAME + HLA confirmation and sponsor confirmation osteosarcoma is in scope.
